content:
**Radstag Meat** is a consumable in *Fallout 76*.

The raw, uncooked meat of a Radstag. It can be consumed raw to satisfy a very large amount of hunger with a very high dose of Radiation and high chance for disease or can be cooked for additional benefits. It can also be used to craft explosive bait after starting the Trappers segment of the Flavors of Mayhem quest.

- One piece is guaranteed to drop by killed radstags. Use of the Butcher's Bounty perk gives a chance for an extra piece to drop.
- Two can be found on hanging radstags at Toxic Larry's Meat 'n Go.
- Two can be found on hanging radstags at the campsite in Flatwoods.
- Two can be found on dead radstags in The Freak Show.
